DEV_SITE_SERVICE_HTTP_HOST.description: Host:port for the HTTP listener (e.g. 0.0.0.0:3099). Port is parsed from the value after the last colon.

DEV_SITE_REPO_ROOT.description: Absolute path to the git repository to analyze. Defaults to process.cwd() when unset.

DEV_SITE_PRODUCT_ROOT.description: Path prefix within the repo to analyze (e.g. base or daemon). Empty string = whole repo.

DEV_SITE_MAIN_REF.description: Main branch ref used for history walks and is-main-ancestor checks.

DEV_SITE_DB_PATH.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file. Defaults to ./data/dev-site.sqlite beside the runnable HTTP package.

DEV_SITE_STATIC_DIR.description: Optional absolute path to built SPA assets. When set, Express serves the UI and API on one port.
